Name: Guns Valley
Author: chin258456
Description:
[b][center]GUNS VALLEY: TOOLS FOR THE HOSTILE WILDERNESS.[/center]

[/b]Agriculture is the heart of the Valley, but ballistics are the backbone. When the Adventurer's Guild swords aren't enough to clear the deeper floors, trust in steel, powder, and grit.

[list]
[*][b][/b][b][/b][b]The Zapper (Pistol):[/b] It’s cheap, it’s dirty, and it works. Good for keepin' the slimes off your boots.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/18900989-1769897895.png[/img]﻿[*][b]The Rattlesnake (Machine Pistol):[/b] Makes a hell of a noise. Scares the crows, kills the bats, pisses off the neighbors
[/list]        [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/18900989-1769897953.png[/img]
﻿[list]
[*][b][/b][b][/b][b]The Long-Range Eliminator (Rifle) [/b] Designed for the farmer who prefers to handle business from a distance. High muzzle velocity ensures your target stays down before it even knows you’re in the room."
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/18900989-1769897971.png[/img]﻿[*][b]The 'Grandpa’s Secret' (Elephant Gun):[/b] Found this under the floorboards of the old shed. I fired it once and woke up three days later in Harvey’s clinic. You want it? It’s yours.    
[*][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/18900989-1769897999.png[/img]
[/list][list]
[*][b]NEW ON STOCK! LONG REQUESTED SERVICE RIFLE: [/b]A rugged, dependable firearm used by security forces and militaries.
[*][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/18900989-1770294350.jpg[/img]﻿﻿
[/list]


This's a add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16767]Archery[/url] mod. it add 4 new weapons to the game along with it ammunitions sold at adventurer's guild.

I'm so new to modding and it's a rabbit hole I just jump into, I puzzling mods from years ago that didn't worked like ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17604]Shoot First (a Blaster Mod)[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16865]Prairie King Firearms[/url] and so thankful for them to pave the way for this.

To use the weapons you need ammunitions which you need to applied to the guns the same way applied baits to the fishing rods, left click the baits in your inventory then right click to the gun you want. 
Then after equipped the gun you hold down attack button until character ready their guns.

If anyone encountered a problems please let me know so I can hustle my way to get them fixed.

Due there're political turmoil in my country + neighboring country that affected my usual life, the further development would be halt until further notice
